findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the ice machine is still soiled with some mold on interior baffles after cleaning. PIC was informed and deeper cleaning was conducted during today’s visit. The violation is now considered resolved with no further action needed.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed no paper towel present at the back hand sink. The PIC was informed and paper towels were supplied. Ensure disposable towels are available at all times to promote proper handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following food-contact surfaces to be soiled and in need of cleaning:
1. REPEAT VIOLATION ice machine is soiled with mold on interior baffles
2. Interior of pizza ovens
3. Pizza cutters kept on exterior of ovens
4. Interior and exterior of popcorn machine

Ensure these food-contact surfaces are cleaned as frequently as necessary to prevent an accumulation of soil. A follow-up will be conducted on 12/29/2025 to ensure these items are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the seasoning shaker for the popcorn to be stored open under employee coats and personal items. The popcorn kernel bin under the machine in the cabinet was also observed left open. Ensure these containers are kept away from sources of contamination and sealed tightly when not in use.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the door to the popcorn machine to be damaged and repaired with duct tape. The PIC was informed that duct tape is not a smooth, easily cleanable surface and therefore cannot be used on food-contact surfaces. Ensure the door to the machine is repaired with an approved material.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a small freshwater leak in a copper pipe near the back triple sink. This pipe previously supplied water to a dish machine. This machine has since been removed and the pipe is no longer needed. The PIC has plans to cap off and remove the unnecessary plumbing. Ensure these repairs are completed prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the coving around the bar to be peeling from the wall. Ensure the coving is sealed or replaced to prevent moisture accumulation in the wall. 

Inspectors also noted mold accumulating on the wall and floor below the freshwater leak mentioned in violation #51. Ensure the flooring and wall is cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
